title: Juicy Argentinian Chorizo Empanadas
description: Savory empanadas filled with spicy Argentine chorizo and topped with fresh cilantro. Perfect for a post-workout meal or snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt. Gradually add the cold butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic. Place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass. You should be able to get about 12 circles.
In a pan over medium heat, cook the chorizo, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Place a tablespoon of the chorizo mixture onto one half of each dough circle. Brush the edges with a little water, then fold the dough in half and press the edges together with a fork to seal.
In a small bowl, beat the eggs and mix with the chopped cilantro. Brush the tops of the empanadas with the egg wash.
Place the empanadas on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
